assignment.core_question: Har islandske vælgere afvist at genoptage EU-optagelsesforhandlingerne, og hvilke hovedargumenter prægede afstemningen?

sources.name: Landskjörstjórn / Ísland.is
sources.authoritative_for: Referendum question, date and advisory legal status

sources.name: Reuters
sources.authoritative_for: Independent reporting on final result, campaign arguments and government response

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.authoritative_for: Independent reporting on result, referendum scope and campaign arguments

sources.name: RÚV
sources.authoritative_for: Independent Icelandic domestic coverage of the referendum result

sources.name: Landskjörstjórn / Ísland.is – endelig optællingsmeddelelse
sources.authoritative_for: Official vote totals, percentages and turnout after counting

notes: Reuters supplied the final percentages, campaign arguments and government response.
AP independently confirmed the result and clarified the referendum's limited scope plus arguments from both camps.
RÚV provided independent Icelandic domestic coverage and was used as a third editorial perspective rather than as a duplicate wire source.

A post-research primary-source recheck found the electoral authority's published turnout at 82.6 percent, while Reuters/RÚV reported 82.5 percent; the article therefore follows the primary official figure.

claims.claim: Nej-siden fik 52,8 procent og ja-siden 47,2 procent.
claims.notes: Official count: 118,040 no votes and 105,339 yes votes among 223,379 valid votes.

claims.claim: Den islandske valgmyndighed opgjorde valgdeltagelsen til 82,6 procent.
claims.notes: Landskjörstjórn reports 225,031 votes cast from 272,591 registered voters (82.6%). Reuters and RÚV reported 82.5%; the article follows the primary official figure.

claims.claim: Afstemningen gjaldt genoptagelse af EU-optagelsesforhandlinger og var rådgivende.
Fiskeri og selvbestemmelse var centrale argumenter på nej-siden.
Ja-siden pegede blandt andet på økonomisk stabilitet, lavere renter, mulig eurobrug og tættere europæisk samarbejde/sikkerhed.
claims.notes: Artiklen formulerer argumenterne som kampagnepåstande, ikke som dokumenterede effekter.

claims.claim: Premierminister Kristrún Frostadóttir sagde, at regeringen ikke vil gå videre med EU-sporet i den nuværende periode og vil fokusere på EØS-forholdet.
Island søgte om EU-medlemskab i 2009, og forhandlingerne blev senere standset.
claims.notes: Reuters angiver at en EU-skeptisk regering afsluttede forhandlingerne i 2013; AP beskriver at de blev indledt efter finanskrisen og senere afsluttet.

notes: Result cross-checked between the electoral authority, Reuters and AP; referendum scope checked against Iceland's National Electoral Commission.
A final primary-source recheck corrected turnout from the wire-service figure of 82.5 percent to the electoral authority's 82.6 percent.
Campaign arguments are explicitly attributed as arguments rather than stated as settled causal facts.

desk_recheck.rationale: The official count and multiple independent reports confirm the result. The primary-source turnout correction has been incorporated before publication, and the story retains clear European public-interest relevance.
